How the job runs02

No mud pit left behind. Five steps, in order.

01

Locate

We call 811 and wait for the paint marks before any machine touches dirt.

02

Stake & laser

Grade stakes set the cut and fill; a rotating laser checks every pass.

03

Cut & haul

Topsoil stripped and stockpiled or hauled; rock broken if ledge shows up.

04

Compact in lifts

Fill placed 6–8 inches at a time and packed with a plate compactor.

05

Finish grade & seed

Final rake pass at 5% away from the house, then straw and seed on bare soil.

The number on the sheet is the number you pay03

  • 811 locate first

    We text you photos of the paint marks before the bucket swings. If a line isn't marked, we don't dig.

  • Rock clause, written down

    If we hit Ozark chert or sandstone ledge, the per-hour rock rate on your sheet kicks in. No surprise change order.

  • Your final bill stays within 10% of the written number unless you change the job.
